implementation: One optional shared unshadowed selection marker follows persistent identity through native renderer publication. No per-entity nodes or GDScript tracking loop. Marker disappears outside rendered selection, on stale records, suspension and epoch-invalid command. Deleted marker references resolve safely by ObjectID.
scope: Visual/editor correctness only; existing actor timing and mixed-frame failures remain open. Marker can be occluded by geometry. No navigation, animation or crowd qualification.
